title: Act 1 - Segment 2: Mt. Moon to Cerulean City (Cascade Badge)
vanilla_divergence_alerts: HM Slaves: 100% eliminated by 9 reusable Key Item tools. Do NOT instruct players to teach field moves to party members.
Friendship: Eliminated. All friendship evolutions use static level thresholds (e.g. Baby Pokémon evolve at Lv. 15).
Trade Evolutions: Evolve naturally at Level 40 OR via Linking Cord (not Level 37).

critical_missables.consequence: RECOMMENDED DOUBLE-AGENT PATH: Agree to join (-5 Karma, but unlocks Rocket missions). By reporting the upcoming Rocket crimes to the Cerulean police officer, you will net +20 Karma total, earning far more Karma than refusing (+5) while securing Diancie!

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Nectar Garden
objectives: Talk to the old man in the Pewter City flower garden.
Deliver pink flowers from Route 2 (Before Forest) for Oran Berry.
Deliver red flowers from Route 3 for Sitrus Berry.
Deliver blue flowers from Route 4 for Lum Berry.
Catch the visiting Oricorio Sensu Style to receive Berry Juice.

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Playing Cupid
objectives: Accept the love letter from the boy in the Cerulean City Hotel.
Defeat Pokémon Breeder Maude on the route south of Cerulean City (Route 5).
Deliver the love letter to Maude to receive 5 Love Balls.

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Johto Pokémon
objectives: Speak to the traveler inside the Cerulean Poké Mart.
Show him any Pokémon native to the Johto region (e.g. Sentret, Hoothoot, Pineco, Ledyba).

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Field Research (Part 1)
objectives: Speak to Professor Oak's aide inside Cerulean City Pokémon Center.
Fuse at least five Pokémon using DNA Splicers.
Meet the aide on Route 24 and catch an Abra to receive the Poké Radar.

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Nugget Bridge Rocket Recruitment
rewards: Access to Team Rocket Cerulean HQ
objectives: Defeat the 5 trainers on Nugget Bridge.
The Team Rocket Grunt at the end offers you to join Team Rocket.

RECOMMENDED DOUBLE-AGENT PATH: Agree to join (-5 Karma, but unlocks Rocket missions). By reporting the upcoming Rocket crimes to the Cerulean police officer, you will net +20 Karma total, earning far more Karma than refusing (+5) while securing Diancie!

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Creepy Crawlies
objectives: Enter the temporary Rocket HQ in Cerulean City disguised in your Rocket uniform.
Speak to the Team Rocket Captain and clear the bug infestation in the basement.

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: No Fishing Zone
active_and_ongoing_quests.missable_deadline: Before defeating Misty (Gym 2) for police report; Gym 8 for Rocket turn-in
rewards: ₽8,000 (Rocket turn-in) OR +10 Karma & Diancie Police Path (Officer Jenny report)
objectives: Accept mission from Rocket Captain to intimidate fishermen on Nugget Bridge.
UNDERCOVER INFORMANT PATH: DO NOT intimidate the fishermen. Instead, immediately speak to the Police Officer in Cerulean City blocking the Route 5 entrance.
Report Team Rocket's harassment to the police BEFORE defeating Misty to earn +10 Karma and unlock the Police Pinkan Island heist!

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Disobedient Pokémon
rewards: ₽4,000 + Azurill/Zubat (Rocket) OR +10 Karma & Diancie Police Path (Officer Jenny report)
objectives: Accept mission to discipline a disobedient stolen Pokémon.
UNDERCOVER INFORMANT PATH: Take the Pokémon directly to the Cerulean police officer to report Pokémon theft.
Earn +10 Karma and advance the Police Informant storyline towards Diancie.

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Gran Theft Pokémon!
objectives: Follow Team Rocket Executive Petrel to steal a rare Pokémon from a young trainer.
Advance the Team Rocket infiltrator storyline to Celadon City.

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Mythical Mew Encounter
objectives: Climb to Mt. Moon Summit.
Requires a Karma score of +20 or higher to trigger Mew's presence!
Achieved easily by following the Undercover Informant path (reporting 2 Rocket crimes = +20 Karma) and avoiding egg theft.

Route 3.lead_summary:
Route 3 is located between Pewter City and Mt. Moon, it is a route with a lot of trainers. The first time the player accesses this route, a scientist explains the hidden ability swarms.
When the player arrives, the Pokémon center is missing a nurse so you can't heal your Pokémon at first. The player has to talk to this nurse healing a Geodude, then, Brock will come help and replace the nurse. She will then be able to heal your Pokémon at the Pokémon center.
You will have to go through Mt. Moon to defeat team Rocket grunts.

Mt. Moon.lead_summary:
Mt. Moon is located between Route 3 and Route 4.
The first time the player goes through Mt. Moon, it is filled by Team Rocket Grunts. Once they leave, the player can choose to keep between the Helix Fossil or the Dome Fossil.
On B2F, there is an exit to Mt. Moon Square. A second entrance from Route 4 leads to Mt. Moon Summit.

Cerulean City.lead_summary:
Cerulean City has four entries: Route 4 from the West, Route 24 from the North, Route 9 from the East, and Route 5 to the South.
This city contains Cerulean City's Gym, with Misty as its leader.
The path south will be blocked by a police officer until the player claims the Cascade Badge.

authoring_guidance.splicing_safety: Explicitly state: HEAD species, BODY species, and WHICH ability to select at the DNA Splicer prompt.
authoring_guidance.unfuse_safety: Unfusing at Pokémon Mart costs $300. Check move retention before unfusing.
authoring_guidance.gym_duel_rule: Strict 2v2 party limit! Instruct player to deposit extra party members in the PC before entering gym arena.
authoring_guidance.time_of_day: Provide Day/Night alternative suggestions so players are never blocked by real-time spawn windows.
authoring_guidance.stone_evolutions: Advisory: Do NOT use evolution stones prematurely on stone-evolvers (e.g. Nidorino) before key level-up moves are learned.
authoring_guidance.undercover_informant_rocket: Guide player to join Team Rocket for disguises/missions, BUT report crimes to police officer for +10 Karma and Diancie unlock!
